description: A1 daily_phrase: one observable learning goal through exact review assets; human rubric required.

input.idea: Teach the English phrase 'Excuse me' to worldwide non-native beginners (A1 planning level). After this lesson the learner can politely get someone's attention to ask a simple question. Show a clear everyday scene and a short natural dialogue. Limit this lesson to getting attention; do not claim this phrase always replaces an apology. Make exactly 4 slides. Use simple English-first teaching with visual explanation, no mandatory translation. End with one small practice action. CEFR labels are planning guides, not certification.
